response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience across languages, testing tools, and developer tooling, but the resume shows no evidence of people management or team leadership experience, which is a core, non-negotiable requirement for this Level II Manager role. Titles are exclusively IC-focused (Senior/Staff/Software Developer, Founder) with no direct reports, performance reviews, or org-level leadership mentioned.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and CI/CD infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems with 15+ years of experience
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and courses (Selenium, Web Internals, TDD)
concerns: No evidence of people management, direct reports, or formal team leadership responsibilities
No mention of conducting one-on-ones, performance expectations, or professional development of others
Career trajectory is entirely IC-track (Senior/Staff Developer) despite long tenure, with no manager title progression

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools and testing infrastructure background
No demonstrated organizational leadership or roadmap ownership at team level
